audit: Facts-only mechanical audit; no semantic grading.
authorship_limit: This auditor authored case21 and its pre-run rubric and knew both arm names. The audit is separate from TASK execution, not blinded or independent semantic grading. It makes no recommendation-quality, superiority, reliability or causal claim.

hash_methods.bytes: SHA-256 over actual bytes, including original unnormalized logs, original-input/original-instructions, final workspace files and every retained archive file. archive-provenance.json was also hashed.
hash_methods.sorted_object: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(relativePathToSha256Map).sort())). This is the before-run.json convention and the default for this summary's map digests.
hash_methods.sorted_entries: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(Object.entries(relativePathToSha256Map).sort()). Earlier receipts used this array serialization.
hash_methods.distinction: The two serializations encode the same relative-path/hash mappings but produce different digest bytes. Both were independently recomputed below; the original receipt was not rewritten.
hash_methods.provenance: Recomputed every archive-provenance.json original_sha256 and archived_sha256 against real source and retained files, then compared exact transformed bytes. Only metadata.json in each run required literal source-run-root replacement with <temporary-run-root>; all other mapped files were byte-identical. No omitted files or missing original snapshots were found.
hash_methods.word_count: Whitespace-delimited words in the complete UTF-8 output.md, including Markdown syntax. No word-count command is visible in either TASK trace.

common_conditions.model_configuration: Host defaults; actual model identifier and full host context are not pinned by these records.
common_conditions.task_context: Each wrapper limits work to local raw inputs and the supplied selected instruction snapshot, forbids rubrics, other outputs/repositories, AGENTS files, browsing, external actions, file edits, implementation and product-test execution.
common_conditions.skill_layout: Scope has only four bandit-scope files under .agents/skills/. Baseline has no PM instruction snapshot and its wrapper explicitly says do not load a PM skill. Both arms retain the same raw request, including literal $bandit-scope.
common_conditions.observed_actions: All completed command items are local cat/rg reads or listings of input and the selected instruction path. No web, external action, product execution, product test, or write command is visible.
common_conditions.scope: Both final workspaces contain only the declared raw and instruction files; all raw and instruction bytes are unchanged. Current raw fixtures, rubric, all 34 skill files, runner and archiver match the before-run receipt.
common_conditions.completion: Both source metadata records report exited with exit_code 0; both valid-JSON traces end in turn.completed. Output files equal their final agent-message text exactly. These are process facts, not quality grades.

verification_totals.note: Counts include separately stored copies, not only unique content. Per-file mappings remain in the two archive-provenance.json files; this summary does not duplicate them.

trace_observations.observation: The first completed command returned the request and listed local paths. The second returned the complete entrypoint, decisions reference, evidence-and-decisions reference and all three supporting raw files. The available agents/openai.yaml was not explicitly read.

rg --files input instructions exited 2 with 'instructions: No such file or directory' while listing the four input files. The next cat command exited 0 and returned all four raw files completely. No PM snapshot or PM read is visible. This recovered listing error is retained, not confused with the terminal exit0.

The final agent artifact is at line8 and turn.completed at line9 in each trace. Empty stderr.txt does not erase the baseline command-level error stored in events. Counts below 600 establish observed cap compliance only, not a counting mechanism.

limits: The raw task is synthetic and author-designed; two fresh threads are not a quality benchmark, customer evidence or a reliability estimate.
Local unsigned receipts, metadata UTC timestamps and hash consistency are not trusted execution attestation. Ephemeral flags and distinct thread IDs do not prove absence of all hidden host context.
Read evidence means complete source text appeared in recorded command output, not proof that every instruction was applied. No automatic host-loading behavior is inferred.
No semantic grades, instruction edits, rubric edits, raw-output edits, new TASKs or product tests were performed for this audit.
